description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a route that utilizes dependency injection via the Depends system. It includes a data structure for query parameters and a route handler that processes query parameters and returns a subset of a mock database.

classes.name: CommonQueryParams
classes.description: A class encapsulating common query parameters such as 'q', 'skip', and 'limit' to be used as a dependency in route handlers.

methods.description: Async route handler for GET /items/ that uses dependency injection to access query parameters and returns filtered items from a mock database.
